text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at a Kansai food fair, I spot
Tamamo
Cross and Super Creek touring
the stalls.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Tamtam. This stall's selling the
grilled squid
you were looking for.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Good eye, Creek!
Hello,
ma'am! Hit me with the goods!

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome... The Osaka-style grilled
squid,
right? Ya both havin' one?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Um, you seem kinda down, ma'am.

Somethin' wrong?

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sucks to say, but business hasn't been
great. The
folk here can't tell the
difference between
Osaka-style grilled
squid 'n their local stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
And I bet you've been pourin' your heart
into
makin' these... Now I'm feelin' down
too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'll go 'n attract some customers
for ya!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If that's the plan, I'll help. We can
accomplish
more as a pair.

text_block_list.name: Food Stall Lady
text_block_list.text:
You'd really do that? Well, if you two
aren't the
kindest souls I ever met!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Just wait—you'll be up to your
ears in
customers before long!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two! Can I interest you in some
delish
grilled squid?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Grilled squid? But you can get that
anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Think again! This isn't your ordinary
grilled squid!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's an Osakan specialty, grilled in a
batter like a
crepe! Buy now to get a
bargain—one pack for a
measly five
million yen!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tamtam, is that true? Is it really a luxury
cuisine?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Like hell it is! I'm doin' a bit, duh!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But as a grilled squid connoisseur, I'd pay five million for this—and that's a guarantee!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tamtam... I didn't know grilled squid got
you so...
fired up.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I—wait, was that a joke? That's
s'posed to
be my turf!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I love the comedy act! Maybe I'll
give that
squid a try!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y'mean it?! Then that stall over there's
where you
wanna go!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's keep this rolling! You
there, hot
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's keep this rolling! You
there, hot
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't you a trainer from Tracen?
Were you
watchin' us?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's 'cause business is more than just numbers—you gotta really connect to people!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But we're just chatting to them, aren't
we?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but they can tell we're doin' it
with heart!
We wouldn't have that if we
didn't wanna help the
squid lady!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross

with heart!
We wouldn't have that if we
didn't wanna help the
squid lady!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for yer patronage! Don't hold
back—eat
till you're bursting!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! ♪ Having fun, Tamtam?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course I am! Business done right makes
everyone
happy!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm sellin' squid 'n smiles—nothin' beats
that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Course! I bet the squid lady's grinnin' ear
to ear
right now!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You're such a lovely girl, Tamtam.
Come
here, let me pat your head! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Da hell?! Quit it with the baby
treatment!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Save the praise for later—we've still got
squid to
sell, yeah?!
